zh-Hans: 快捷窗口支持在 360–720pt 范围内调整宽度，并记住尺寸
长目录名称不再挤出侧栏和工具栏，设置窗口会进入请求的页面
修复设置和快捷窗口首次打开或系统缩放后的窗口按钮错位
en: Resize the quick window from 360 to 720 pt and keep your preferred dimensions
Long folder names fit the header, and Settings opens the requested pane
Window controls stay aligned when Settings and the quick window first open or zoom
